title: Hamster holding a heart

    <ellipse cx='66' cy='64' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#E8A44C'/>

    <path d='M50 78 C42 68 32 70 32 60 C32 53 40 51 46 57 L50 61 L54 57 C60 51 68 53 68 60 C68 70 58 68 50 78 Z' fill='#F2467E'/>
